notes: Your sources, everywhere. Picking a main source now actually runs the app: Popular and Latest on Home, in Browse and in Stories all come from the site you chose, with real feeds from every source — and each shelf says whose it is. Comics and books get their own home site (Settings › Your sources). Open a series and it comes from your site first; anything you're already reading stays put, and the switcher is there when a title isn't available. Books also gained a Popular/Latest toggle.
